facts.text: Tim mentions that the picture is from MinaLima, the company that created all the props for the Harry Potter films.

evidence.quote: That picture is from MinaLima. They created all the props for the Harry Potter films, and I love their work.

facts.text: Tim states that he has many reminders of the Harry Potter world, which he describes as a way to escape reality.

evidence.quote: I have lots of reminders of it - kind of a way to escape reality.

facts.text: Tim confirms that the reminders help him escape the daily grind and mentions a chance to visit more places related to the Harry Potter world in the future.

evidence.quote: Those reminders really help. And there's definitely a chance I'll be visiting more HP spots in the future.
